purpose: Test whether a deterministic multi-anchor canonical teacher-target corpus stabilizes rebuild fitting, and separately whether increasing canonical corpus volume adds necessary stability beyond standardization.

immutable_prior_failure.rule: This research cannot reopen, promote, reweight, subset-select, or otherwise rehabilitate the failed K=12 candidate.

control.corpus: Exact original member-01 corpus used by the completed V2 shared-corpus pilot.
control.rule: Reuse the eight existing V2 control artifacts and evaluate them on the new common bank; do not refit the control.

canonical_sources.selection_rule: Same deterministic stride-3 anchors preregistered before the factorial result; no anchor is added, removed, or chosen from performance.
canonical_sources.dedup_rule: Deduplicate by exact observation bytes plus legal-action mask and hard-fail if duplicate keys have different teacher targets.
canonical_sources.ordering_rule: After deduplication, order each stream by SHA256 of a frozen stream salt plus exact observation bytes plus legal-action mask. Source/cache traversal order must not determine selection.

fixed_size_canonical.description: Size-matched canonical corpus drawn deterministically from the four-anchor unique union.
fixed_size_canonical.size_basis: Exact structural counts of the member-01 V2 control corpus; counts are inherited for size matching, not chosen from a performance result.

expanded_canonical.description: All unique eligible samples from the same four-anchor canonical union after the same deduplication rules.
expanded_canonical.rule: No new teacher collection is performed and no evaluation-bank state may enter training.

fit_design.seed_matching_rule: Replica i uses the exact same fullpool/specialist fit seeds as V2 control replica i in both canonical treatments.
fit_design.route: postflop made_category>=TRIPS AND FOLD legal -> specialist; otherwise fullpool

fresh_confirmation_bank.rule: Generate the complete 100k bank before policy evaluation. Coverage failure is a mechanical/research-support stop, not a treatment result.

primary_evaluation.method: Run the unchanged original K=8 rebuild-stability evaluator separately on control8, fixed-size-canonical8, and expanded-canonical8 using the exact same fresh bank and original frozen thresholds.
mandatory_ratios: fixed_size_canonical broad mean and p95 divided by control broad mean and p95
expanded_canonical broad mean and p95 divided by control broad mean and p95
expanded_canonical broad mean and p95 divided by fixed_size_canonical broad mean and p95

classification_rule.bank_sensitivity_stop: If the reused V2 control passes the complete original K=8 stability gate on the new bank, stop interpretation and require another preregistered confirmation bank.
classification_rule.standardization_sufficient: Control FAIL and fixed-size canonical PASS. Expanded result remains descriptive; fixed-size standardization is sufficient for the research stability criterion.
classification_rule.expansion_required: Control FAIL, fixed-size canonical FAIL, and expanded canonical PASS.
classification_rule.canonical_corpus_insufficient: Control FAIL and both canonical treatments FAIL.
classification_rule.note: These labels are research guidance only. A treatment PASS does not promote a policy or reopen the failed K=12 candidate.

next_branch_rule.standardization_sufficient: Design a new candidate family around the frozen deterministic fixed-size canonical corpus, then preregister fresh candidate stability/quality/safety before strength.
next_branch_rule.expansion_required: Design a new candidate family around the frozen expanded canonical corpus, then preregister fresh candidate stability/quality/safety before strength.
next_branch_rule.canonical_corpus_insufficient: Do not build a candidate yet; combine canonical corpus construction with an explicit fit/optimization stability intervention and test it research-only.
next_branch_rule.bank_sensitivity_stop: Do not choose a corpus treatment; preregister a second independent 100k confirmation bank.

exclusions: No member selection, dropping, weighting, reseeding, or threshold relaxation.
No training on any stability, factorial, shared-corpus, or confirmation evaluation bank.
No treatment choice based on strength.
